notes.title: Update #4 Optimization!
notes.notes:
Update # 4 is aimed at optimizing the game, and minor changes

- Changed marker icon,
- Added a button to switch between the available languages of the game.
- Optimized, reduced CPU load.

notes.title: Update #3-New features!
notes.notes:
Hi! in today's update, bugs have been fixed and new features added!

Patch note

- Added a new small content, you can find it by jumping into the portal which stands in one of the houses.
- Added ability to save game on F5,
- Added the ability to invert the mouse,
- Added Gameover animation,
- Fixed collisions,
- Fixed a bug with the menu,
- Game optimization!

notes.title: Update #2
notes.notes:
Hi! Update #2

- Correction of errors in tasks,
- Fix graphic artifacts,
- Game optimization,
- Changed end-splash,
- Changed camera in the car,
- Not a big change in the behavior of the machine and its physics.

notes.title: Update #1 - is now live!
notes.notes:
Hello, released the first update #1

Where bugs have been fixed

- Fixed AI Drone, now it won't find you through walls.
- Added a infect indicator, now when you are infected, the icon will be filled with green, when the icon is full, your character will die.
- Partially fixed a bug that caused things to fall through the squalor of the wall and floor.
- The game was optimized.
